Subject: Procurement & Marketplace path — Redwood + LumenAI

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap + a few procurement/marketplace questions so we can map the right commercial path: 

Recap (from today's call)
- LumenAI will be evaluating Redwood for inference on customer-facing features (low-latency chat + embeddings).
- Initial scope: 3 dev teams, pilot traffic expected in Q2.

Procurement / commercial questions
1) Preferred purchasing route: do you prefer AWS Marketplace (consolidated billing) or a direct PO + invoice?
2) If PO, who is the procurement owner and what is the approximate PO creation timeline (weeks)?
3) Do you require private offers or contract-level pricing on the Marketplace?
4) Standard payment terms (Net30/Net45) and billing contact?
5) Required paperwork for vendor onboarding (W-9, SOC 2 attestation, security questionnaire)?

Attached I've included: Redwood_SaaS_Procurement_Checklist.pdf and Redwood_Marketplace_AWS_Onboarding.docx — these are short stubs that explain both paths and typical timelines.

Next steps
- If Marketplace: we can start the AWS onboarding and private offer paperwork (if you want contract pricing) and loop our marketplace onboarding lead.
- If PO: share PO flow + contact at your finance team and we'll provision a commercial quote and invoice path.

Would you be able to confirm preferred path and an estimated procurement timeline? Happy to jump on a 30-min call with procurement this week.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumenai.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & Marketplace path — Redwood + LumenAI

Camila — thanks for the clear recap and docs. A few answers from procurement: 

- Preferred route: AWS Marketplace is our preferred path because it ties into our consolidated cloud billing. We would prefer that where possible.
- PO vs private offer: We usually buy via Marketplace; however, for enterprise discounts we can accept a private offer (AWS contract) or a PO/invoice if Marketplace cannot support the commercial terms.
- Timeline: vendor onboarding + internal approvals typically ~4–6 weeks once we have the Marketplace listing / pricing details.
- Paperwork: we will need W-9, SOC 2 type II or attestation, and a short security questionnaire. Please provide the SOC2 report or contact for that.
- Payment terms: Net30 is standard for us.

Questions for Redwood: Do you support creating a private offer on AWS Marketplace? If so, what is required from our side (legal contacts, expected lead time)? Also can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a direct PO (invoice) if we end up not using Marketplace?

Thanks — happy to schedule the procurement call; Priya (cc'd) will be our legal/procurement partner on this.

Best,
Alex
Head of Procurement | LumenAI
alex.johnson@lumenai.com

Alex / Priya — really helpful, thanks. Short answers below and proposed next steps.

1) Private offers on AWS Marketplace: Yes — Redwood supports AWS Marketplace listings and can create private offers / contract pricing. The typical steps are: we prepare the listing + pricing information, your legal signs a private offer, and AWS processes the offer. Lead time is usually 2–4 weeks (depends on negotiation complexity).
2) Direct PO / invoice: Also supported. For Dedicated/Private deployments we commonly do a PO + invoice path (Net30) and can provide monthly or annual invoicing.
3) Paperwork: attaching our standard pack (Redwood_SLA-and-Ordering.csv and the procurement checklist). We can provide SOC 2 type II report under an NDA or via secure transfer — let me know the preferred method.
4) Next steps:
   - Please confirm: Marketplace route (preferred) vs PO route.
   - If Marketplace: we'll begin onboarding with our marketplace lead — I'll need a legal contact for the private offer and the exact billing/account code you want on the Marketplace listing.
   - If PO: share the procurement contact and example PO template so finance can validate.

Proposed time: Wed, Mar 24 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30-min procurement sync. Mateo (cc'd) — our Solutions Engineer — will join for listing/onboarding questions. Marissa (cc'd) will help with commercial packaging.

If that time works I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Thanks,
